properties.text: validate_header must reject blocks whose parent_hash != keccak256(rlp(parent_header)).
properties.assertion: forall block: validate_header(block) => block.header.parent_hash == keccak256(rlp.encode(parent_header))

properties.text: recover_sender must return the correct signer address; forged sender allows unauthorized transfers.
properties.assertion: forall tx: check_transaction(tx).sender == ecrecover(tx.signature, tx.hash)

properties.text: SetCode transactions must have non-empty authorization list; empty list must be rejected.
properties.assertion: forall tx: is_SetCode(tx) => len(tx.authorizations) > 0 OR raise EmptyAuthorizationListError

properties.text: All 8 computed roots/hashes in state_transition must match header values exactly.
properties.assertion: forall block: state_transition(block) => all(computed[i] == header[i] for i in roots)

properties.text: blob_gas_used in header must equal sum of blob gas consumed by all blob transactions.
properties.assertion: forall block: header.blob_gas_used == sum(calculate_total_blob_gas(tx) for tx in blob_txs)

properties.text: check_transaction must reject tx if max_fee_per_gas < base_fee_per_gas for EIP-1559 types.
properties.assertion: forall tx: is_EIP1559(tx) AND tx.max_fee < base_fee => raise InsufficientMaxFeePerGasError

properties.text: Requests must be appended in ascending type order: deposit, withdrawal, consolidation.
properties.assertion: forall block: requests[i].type < requests[j].type for all i < j where types differ

properties.text: check_gas_limit must reject gas_limit changes exceeding parent_gas_limit // 1024.
properties.assertion: forall block: abs(gas_limit - parent_gas_limit) < parent_gas_limit // 1024

properties.text: Block proposer transaction ordering is immutable once block is sealed; no reordering after header commit.
properties.assertion: forall block: tx_trie(block.transactions) == block.header.transactions_root

properties.text: Block RLP size must not exceed MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE before full processing begins.
properties.assertion: forall block: len(rlp.encode(block)) <= MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE OR raise InvalidBlock

properties.text: Blob transactions must have 1..MAX_BLOB_COUNT blobs; zero or excess must be rejected.
properties.assertion: forall tx: is_Blob(tx) => 0 < len(tx.blob_versioned_hashes) <= MAX_BLOB_COUNT

properties.text: Blob transaction gas must not exceed remaining block blob gas limit.
properties.assertion: forall tx, block: is_Blob(tx) => total_blob_gas(tx) <= MAX_BLOB_GAS - blob_gas_used

properties.text: Transaction gas must not exceed block gas limit cap per EIP-7825.
properties.assertion: forall tx: tx.gas <= gas_available (block_gas_limit - block_gas_used)

properties.text: All blob versioned hashes must have version == VERSIONED_HASH_VERSION_KZG (0x01).
properties.assertion: forall tx, h in tx.blob_versioned_hashes: h[0] == VERSIONED_HASH_VERSION_KZG

properties.text: System transactions must originate from SYSTEM_ADDRESS only; external actors cannot forge them.
properties.assertion: forall sys_tx: sys_tx.origin == SYSTEM_ADDRESS AND sys_tx.caller == SYSTEM_ADDRESS

properties.text: Sender must be EOA or have valid delegation code; contracts without delegation cannot send transactions.
properties.assertion: forall tx: sender.code == empty OR is_valid_delegation(sender.code) OR raise InvalidSenderError

properties.text: P2P peers are untrusted; all block data must be validated before state transition.
properties.assertion: forall block from P2P: validate_header(block) AND validate_body(block) before apply_body(block)

properties.text: Transaction senders control all tx fields; validation must reject invalid field combinations.
properties.assertion: forall tx: check_transaction(tx) validates type, fees, gas, nonce, balance, blobs, auth

properties.text: Post-merge blocks must have difficulty=0, nonce=0, empty ommers; deviations are protocol violations.
properties.assertion: forall block: header.difficulty == 0 AND header.nonce == 0x00 AND header.ommers_hash == EMPTY_OMMER_HASH

properties.text: Checked system transactions must target contracts with code and must execute without error.
properties.assertion: forall checked_sys_tx: len(target.code) > 0 AND process_system_transaction().error == None

properties.text: EIP-7623 calldata floor gas cost must be enforced post-refund to prevent calldata spam.
properties.assertion: forall tx: tx_gas_used >= max(gas_used - refund, calldata_floor_gas_cost)

properties.text: Validation checks in transaction_validation_dispatch are ordered general-to-specific.
properties.assertion: forall tx: validation_order == [type, contract, fee, priority, gas_limit, initcode, blob]

properties.text: Each validation check is mutually exclusive: transaction either passes or raises exactly one error.
properties.assertion: forall tx, check: check(tx) => (pass XOR raise_one_InvalidTransaction_subclass)

properties.text: Block number must be >= 1 and strictly sequential with parent block number.
properties.assertion: forall block: header.number >= 1 AND header.number == parent_header.number + 1

properties.text: Timestamps must be strictly increasing: child.timestamp > parent.timestamp.
properties.assertion: forall block: header.timestamp > parent_header.timestamp

properties.text: Header extra_data must not exceed 32 bytes.
properties.assertion: forall block: len(header.extra_data) <= 32

properties.text: Gas used must not exceed gas limit in validated header.
properties.assertion: forall block: header.gas_used <= header.gas_limit

properties.text: excess_blob_gas must equal calculate_excess_blob_gas(parent) in header validation.
properties.assertion: forall block: header.excess_blob_gas == calculate_excess_blob_gas(parent_header)

properties.text: Ommers tuple must be empty in post-merge blocks; non-empty ommers must raise InvalidBlock.
properties.assertion: forall block: block.ommers == () OR raise InvalidBlock

properties.text: Chain retains at most 255 blocks after appending in state_transition.
properties.assertion: forall chain: len(chain.blocks) <= 255 after state_transition

properties.text: get_last_256_block_hashes returns at most 256 hashes in increasing block number order.
properties.assertion: forall chain: len(get_last_256_block_hashes(chain)) <= 256

properties.text: Base fee increases at least 1 when parent gas used exceeds target (min increase invariant).
properties.assertion: forall block: parent_gas_used > target => base_fee_delta >= 1

properties.text: Base fee change bounded by parent_base_fee // BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR per block.
properties.assertion: forall block: abs(base_fee - parent_base_fee) <= parent_base_fee // DENOMINATOR + 1

properties.text: Gas limit must be >= GAS_LIMIT_MINIMUM (5000) at all times.
properties.assertion: forall block: header.gas_limit >= GAS_LIMIT_MINIMUM

properties.text: Sender nonce must exactly match transaction nonce; mismatch must be rejected.
properties.assertion: forall tx: get_account(state, sender).nonce == tx.nonce OR raise NonceMismatchError

properties.text: Sender balance must cover max_gas_fee + value + blob_gas_fee before execution.
properties.assertion: forall tx: sender.balance >= effective_gas_fee + tx.value + blob_gas_fee

properties.text: Beacon roots system tx must execute before any user transactions in apply_body.
properties.assertion: forall block: exec_order(beacon_roots_sys_tx) < exec_order(user_tx[0])

properties.text: History storage system tx must execute after beacon roots and before user transactions.
properties.assertion: forall block: exec_order(beacon_roots) < exec_order(history_storage) < exec_order(user_tx[0])

properties.text: Transactions must be processed in sequential order within a block.
properties.assertion: forall block, i < j: exec_order(tx[i]) < exec_order(tx[j])

properties.text: Withdrawals must be processed after all user transactions complete.
properties.assertion: forall block: exec_order(last_user_tx) < exec_order(process_withdrawals)

properties.text: General purpose requests processed last in apply_body, after withdrawals.
properties.assertion: forall block: exec_order(process_withdrawals) < exec_order(process_general_purpose_requests)

properties.text: Gas refund capped at gas_used // 5 per EIP-3529.
properties.assertion: forall tx: tx_gas_refund <= (tx.gas - gas_left) // 5

properties.text: Miner receives only priority fee portion, not base fee.
properties.assertion: forall tx: coinbase_credit == tx_gas_used * (effective_gas_price - base_fee_per_gas)

properties.text: Nonce must be incremented before message execution, not after.
properties.assertion: forall tx: increment_nonce(sender) happens before process_message_call(msg)

properties.text: Withdrawal balance changes are always increases, never decreases (Gwei to Wei scaled).
properties.assertion: forall wd: post_balance(wd.address) == pre_balance(wd.address) + wd.amount * 10^9

properties.text: Receipt succeeded field is true iff execution error is None.
properties.assertion: forall tx: receipt.succeeded == (tx_output.error is None)

properties.text: System transaction gas is fixed at SYSTEM_TRANSACTION_GAS (30M); no external control.
properties.assertion: forall sys_tx: sys_tx.gas == SYSTEM_TRANSACTION_GAS AND sys_tx.value == 0

properties.text: Deposit requests parsed from logs, not system transactions; withdrawal/consolidation from checked sys tx.
properties.assertion: forall block: deposit_requests == parse_deposit_requests(block_output.logs)

properties.text: Blob and SetCode transactions cannot create contracts (to field must be an Address).
properties.assertion: forall tx: (is_Blob(tx) OR is_SetCode(tx)) => isinstance(tx.to, Address)

properties.text: max_fee_per_gas must be >= max_priority_fee_per_gas for EIP-1559 transaction types.
properties.assertion: forall tx: is_EIP1559(tx) => tx.max_fee >= tx.max_priority_fee

properties.text: Blob validation short-circuits on first invalid hash; all preceding hashes were valid.
properties.assertion: forall tx, i: invalid_hash_at(i) => all(valid_hash(j) for j < i)

properties.text: apply_fork for Osaka is identity; state must not be modified during fork application.
properties.assertion: forall state: apply_fork(state) == state (identity transformation)

properties.text: Unchecked system tx does not validate code existence or result; only used for non-critical calls.
properties.assertion: forall unchecked_sys_tx: no_validation_on(target.code, execution_result)

properties.text: max_fee_per_blob_gas must be >= blob_gas_price for blob transaction acceptance.
properties.assertion: forall tx: is_Blob(tx) => tx.max_fee_per_blob_gas >= calculate_blob_gas_price(header)

properties.text: Base fee calculation must match exactly for equal, above, and below target gas scenarios.
properties.assertion: forall block: header.base_fee == calculate_base_fee_per_gas(parent) OR raise InvalidBlock
